author: Noema III
title: DSConv-PM v7b — Dilated + attention pooling, dataset-aware reverse and dropout, AdamW(wd=0.012,0.9,0.999)
abstract: Builds on v7: dilated DSConv backbone with power-mean + attention pooling; disables reverse only for CRI-Off; adds dataset-aware dropout (higher for classification, lower for regression); stronger AdamW (wd=0.012, b1=0.9,b2=0.999) to stabilize regression tasks.
